text:
owen: Quick heads-up - PR #524 preview shows missing code fencing for the Rust SDK example on Vercel. Locally `mkdocs serve` renders fine.
rana: can you paste the preview URL? I'll check the build logs.
owen: https://vercel.com/redwood-inference/docs/preview/deploy_100101 - build shows `yarn docs:build` succeeded but linter step removed fenced code blocks? Not sure.
ci-bot: build log snippet: 
```
[build] Running markdown lint...
[lint] warning: md033 code fence style (fenced) autofix applied
[lint] Applied autofix to docs/sdk/rust.md
```
megan: ah, our markdownlint config has an autofix rule that converted triple backticks to indented code blocks in some cases, and our post-processing strips indented blocks. We changed the lint rules last week.
rana: fix: update mdlint config to not autofix code-fence style, and add a CI guard that fails on autofix changes in docs PRs (so authors see them locally).
owen: I can push a tiny change to restore fenced backticks and add a PR note about running `yarn docs:lint --no-fix`. Will need a quick review.
megan: +1. Also add a short note to CONTRIBUTING.md: "For docs PRs, do not rely on autofix; run the linter locally and commit fixes yourself."
ci-bot: preview redeploy queued by @owen (build 100102).
rana: I'll eyeball the PR once it's up. If green we can merge in the 12:00 PT docs merge slot.
owen: thanks all, pushing now.
